 Jessica Chastain transforms into Jessica Rabbit for Flaunt
 Published on November 18, 2026 | Translated from Spanish 
 Category: Film and TV › Actors and directors 
 Actress Jessica Chastain has recreated the look of Jessica Rabbit, the animated character from Who Framed Roger Rabbit, in a photo shoot for Flaunt magazine. The images, published by photographer Greg Swales on Instagram, show the red silk dress and long gloves of the animation icon. The characterization comes after Halloween and confirms the enduring relevance of the classic design as a current aesthetic reference.
 From celluloid to render: character design that endures 🎨
 The character of Jessica Rabbit was born from traditional animation work, with hand-drawn lines and a color palette limited by the techniques of the time. Decades later, her design still works as a reference in digital photographic productions. The silhouette of the dress, the proportion of the gloves and the chromatic contrast are elements that today's artists replicate with editing and retouching tools. That transfer from animated drawing to photographic format demonstrates how a well-constructed character design maintains its visual reading regardless of the technical medium.
 Heidi Klum already did it before and nobody remembers 🙄
 It is curious that every time someone dresses as Jessica Rabbit it is announced as a revelation. Heidi Klum already did it, Chloe Bailey did too, and the red dress keeps appearing as if it were new. The next time someone discovers the costume, it might be worth checking the archive before publishing the finding. The character has more of a track record than many current careers.
